project: ZSim i18n, Disc Sets & Sim Config
description: ZSim Analyzer 五项改进：驱动盘套装层级界面完善、全界面 i18n 国际化补齐、模拟配置循环/完整双模式、模拟次数默认视图调整、CSV 数据首次自动导入生成数据库

userStories.title: CSV/XLSX 数据首次自动导入 — 启动时生成 zsim.db
userStories.description: As a new user, I want the app to auto-import CSV/XLSX data from the data/ directory on first startup so that zsim.db is generated without manual steps.
acceptanceCriteria: In lib.rs setup hook, check if data/zsim.db exists
If not: call data_entry::db::init_db to create schema, then scan data/characters/, data/equipment/, data/wengine/ for .csv/.xlsx files
Import order: characters → drive discs → w-engines using existing csv_import.rs functions
If zsim.db already exists, skip auto-import entirely
Import errors are logged but do not block startup
After import, frontend Dashboard shows record counts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 模拟配置 — Rust 后端支持 mode 参数（full/loop）
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the run_simulation Rust command to accept and handle mode (full vs loop) so the simulation terminates correctly based on user selection.
acceptanceCriteria: run_simulation command parses new `mode` field from config JSON: 'full' | 'loop'
full mode: simulation runs until action sequence naturally ends OR max_tick reached (whichever first)
loop mode: simulation repeats the action sequence loop_count times OR max_tick reached (whichever first)
loop_count defaults to 1 when mode is 'full' or not specified
Backward compatible: existing config without mode field defaults to 'full'
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Parses mode (full|loop) and loop_count. Loop mode scales effective workload by loop_count.

userStories.title: 驱动盘套装详情 — 1-6号位驱动盘编辑界面
userStories.description: As a data editor, I want to click into a disc set and edit all 6 slot positions' drive discs in one unified view.
acceptanceCriteria: Detail page (#/disc-sets/{set_id}) shows set name as title and back button to list
Displays 6 slot sections (slot 1-6), each showing current drive disc data or placeholder for empty slots
Each slot shows: main stat name dropdown (STAT_OPTIONS), main stat value input, up to 4 sub-stat rows (name dropdown + value input)
Empty slots show default values (main_stat_name='ATK', level=15, all sub_stats null)
Each slot has a Save button that calls saveDriveDisc API
Saving a slot refreshes that slot's display without page reload
Layout: vertical stack of 6 collapsible/scrollable slot sections
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Detail view was largely implemented. Fixed title to look up set name from getDiscSets() (falling back to setId). Added slot refresh after save: reloads discs via getDriveDiscsBySetId and updates form values in-place. Back button, 6 slots, main stat dropdown, sub-stat rows, defaults, and save button were already implemented.
